Pilot
Perform Steps 1-7 for pilot groups.
Full deployment
Configure the pilot user groups in Step 5 or add user groups to expand beyond the
pilot and eventually include all of your user accounts.
The following diagram illustrates baseline architecture for Microsoft Defender for Office 365,
which can include a third-party SMTP gateway or on-premises integration. Hybrid coexistence
scenarios (that is, production mailboxes are both on-premises and online) require more
complex configurations and aren't covered in this article or evaluation guidance.
